<Subject 2> is the abandoned town: old plaster and adobe houses with clay-tile roofs, completely empty of people, a small whitewashed church tower with a bronze bell, and the jungle growing back over its edges.
<Picture 1> is the first frame of [Shot 1], showing a high view from just above the clay-tile rooftops at the first light of dawn, looking toward the church bell tower in the center, a thin line of golden light on the far horizon, a few windows below still glowing faintly, fog in the narrow streets, small birds lifting off the roof tiles.
<Picture 2> is the last frame of [Shot 1], showing a frontal close view of the open belfry arch at the top of the whitewashed church tower at sunrise, the bronze bell swinging inside the arch, small birds circling, golden dawn light glowing behind it, rooftop edges along the bottom.

detailed_description:
The target video is a living aged tempera painting in <Subject 1>: the cracked pigment and dry-brush texture stay visible on every surface as it moves, and the light changes like paint glazing over paint.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The bronze bell in the arch begins to swing gently by itself as the dawn light grows. The camera glides forward over the clay-tile rooftops at a slow, steady speed in one continuous move, the roofs sliding away below, the tower growing larger until the open belfry arch fills the frame, the bell swinging inside it and small birds circling the tower against the golden light. The camera is still gliding forward as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.

The bell rings slowly, full and low, its hum carried on the dawn wind, birds' wings fluttering around the tower.
